notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.108

• Lock screen gallery: hold the lock screen and it shrinks into a card. Swipe between your lock screens and tap one to use it. Rename it, delete it, or create a new one with its own wallpaper, clock style (Bold, Light, Serif or Stacked) and colour. It opens once your face is recognised.
• Weather-adaptive lock screen: turn it on for a lock screen and its sky follows the weather outside: drifting clouds, rain, snow, fog, the sun's glow, or stars at night.
